title: hylomecon japonica f. lanceolata
intro: Hylomecon japonica f. lanceolata, commonly known as Japanese leopard's bane, is a flowering plant species in the family Papaveraceae. The plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Japanese leopard's bane include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
